message:
Fixed. "Crème brûlée recipes" now slugs to `creme-brulee-recipes`, and `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The bug was in the vendored `slugify`, which drops non-ASCII characters instead of transliterating them. I didn't touch `vendor/`, as the project notes require. The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`: it decomposes the title (NFD) and strips the combining accent marks before handing it to `slugify`. The change is 2 lines, and the rest of the file is unchanged.

I haven't committed anything.
